landing.title: Study more effectively with
landing.description: Automatic lecture transcription, intelligent study material processing, and test question generation. All in one place.

features.title: Features that make studying easier
features.subtitle: Harness the power of artificial intelligence for more effective learning and exam preparation
features.feature1Description: Record your lecture in real-time using a microphone. AI automatically transcribes speech to text and creates a clear transcript with editing options.
features.feature2Description: Upload PDF or Word documents. AI analyzes them and prepares study materials precisely according to your exam questions from the provided materials.
features.feature3Description: Based on your materials, AI creates test questions for review. Perfect for exam preparation and knowledge verification.

howItWorks.title: How does it work?
howItWorks.subtitle: Three simple steps to more effective studying
howItWorks.step1Description: Create a free account and start using all the app's features right away.
howItWorks.step2Title: Upload materials or record a lecture
howItWorks.step2Description: Add your study materials (PDF, Word) or start recording a lecture in real-time.
howItWorks.step3Description: AI processes your materials, creates study guides, test questions, and helps you prepare efficiently.

cta.title: Ready to study
cta.subtitle: Join hundreds of students who are already using AI to improve their studies
cta.review1Text: This tool completely changed the way I study. I no longer have to spend hours transcribing lectures, everything is saved automatically.
cta.review2Text: Generating test questions is great for exam preparation. I finally know what to focus on and what I should know.
cta.review3Text: Simple and intuitive interface. I upload a PDF and in a few minutes I have study materials ready. Brilliant!
